## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any relevant checks you could not run.

## Review notes

Include any storage, import compatibility, authentication, or deployment implications. For interface changes, attach a screenshot with synthetic data when useful.

- [ ] Examples, fixtures, screenshots, and attachments contain no personal journal data or secrets.
- [ ] Documentation and localization are updated where needed.
